clue.text: Worker wearing flat hat tears tight-fitting trousers

parts.note: a cap is a flat, peaked hat

indicators.note: the worker is dressed in the hat and tears, so its letters sit inside theirs

parts.note: tears as a verb, rips apart
the ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A cloth-capped labourer is ripping a pair of snug trousers.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: these are close-fitting calf-length trousers named after the Italian island of Capri.

clue.text: Rough route, it's said

indicators.note: it's said means the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: a course is a route

explanation.surface: A road said to be bumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: coarse means rough in texture or crude in manner.

clue.text: Page about marvellous sort of dwelling

parts.note: re means about or concerning
fab, short for fabulous, means marvellous

explanation.surface: A page of writing raving about a wonderful type of home.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a prefabricated house, built in factory sections, common in post-war Britain.

clue.text: Expecting win, they may fail abysmally

indicators.note: abysmally means terribly, so the letters come out badly arranged

explanation.surface: A team anticipating victory might lose terribly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expecting' reads as anticipating victory, but means pregnant.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphemism: both phrases are polite ways of saying a woman is pregnant.

clue.text: A new piece of advice regarding appetiser

parts.note: a tip is a piece of advice
as to means regarding

explanation.surface: Some fresh advice about what to order as a starter.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Italian starter of cold meats, olives and vegetables served before a meal.

clue.text: Unconvincing leader of gang's obsession

parts.note: a thin excuse is unconvincing

indicators.note: leader of means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A gang boss's flimsy fixation.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to have a thing about something is to be fixated on it.

clue.text: Member's parking skill

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
art is skill, as in the art of conversation

explanation.surface: Someone in a club is good at parking the car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' means a component or limb, not a club member.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a member is a constituent piece of a whole, such as a limb of the body.

clue.text: Stair repaired with effort and great skill

indicators.note: repaired means put back together, here in a different order

parts.note: a try is an effort or attempt

explanation.surface: A staircase fixed with real craftsmanship.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: creative ability or craftsmanship of a high order.

clue.text: A father feeding spoiled brats in a place that serves light snacks

definitions.text: a place that serves light snacks

indicators.note: feeding means going into, so these letters go inside the others
spoiled means messed up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A dad feeding his indulged children at a casual eatery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiled' rearranges BRATS into TSBAR, and 'feeding' puts APA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a bar of Spanish origin serving small savoury dishes to share.

clue.text: Indicate position of dog and cross-country racer

parts.note: to point to something is to indicate where it is
a pointer is a gun dog breed

explanation.surface: Show where the dog is.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a horse running in point-to-point steeplechases over open countryside.

clue.text: A well-bred fellow broker

parts.note: a gent, short for gentleman, is a well-bred man

explanation.surface: A gentlemanly stockbroker is described.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a broker acts on behalf of others in a deal, as a representative does.

clue.text: Consider short leg spinner, balding

indicators.note: short means the word for consider loses its final letter

parts.note: to think is to consider
ON is the leg side in cricket
a top is a spinning toy

explanation.surface: Assessing a short leg fielder and a spin bowler who are both losing their hair.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket surface hides it: in cricket the on side is also called the leg side, so 'leg' gives ON, and the spinner is a toy top, not a bowler. 'short' cuts the K from THINK.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: someone losing hair on the crown is described as going bald on the head.

clue.text: Develop figure at college

parts.note: a shape is a figure
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student develops a better physique while away at university.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to improve or progress satisfactorily, coming along into proper form.

clue.text: Excited seeing son's birth

indicators.note: excited letters are stirred up, so these are rearranged

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A parent thrilled at witnessing their boy being born.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a genesis is an origin or coming into being, also the first book of the Bible.

clue.text: General panic when crooked lawyer in Michigan initially absconded

indicators.note: in places the earlier words within the state abbreviation

parts.note: MI is the postal abbreviation for Michigan
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
a shyster is an unscrupulous lawyer

indicators.note: initially means take only the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Widespread alarm after a dishonest Michigan attorney flees.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: collective hysteria is a panic spreading through a whole crowd or population.

clue.text: Does one need a craft to be a member here?

definitions.text: Does one need a craft to be a member here?

parts.words: Does one need a craft to be a member here?
parts.note: craft reads as a skill or trade, as for a guild, but means a boat, which a sailing society's members own

explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' suggests a trade guild; here it is a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sailing association whose members generally own pleasure boats.

clue.text: Captain appearing with sailor's fish

parts.note: skip, short for skipper, is a captain
jack, as in Jack Tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A captain shows up with a seaman's catch.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a striped tuna, also called bonito, is this kind of sea creature.

clue.text: Shock loss bound to divide a government agency in America

indicators.note: to divide means to split the following letters by sitting among them

parts.note: the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency
to lope is to run with long bounding strides

explanation.surface: A sudden blow bound to split a US intelligence agency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock' is a shock of hair, not a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Medical term: a condition in which hair falls out, so a mop of hair is lost.

clue.text: Toy poodle is plastered with cake

indicators.note: plastered means drunk, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A toy poodle is smeared with cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toy poodle' looks like one phrase (a small breed), but 'Toy' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tube of mirrors and coloured glass making changing patterns is a classic children's plaything.

clue.text: Remember to cancel

definitions.meaning: to withdraw or summon back, as with a faulty product or an ambassador

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: calling something back to mind, and calling something back officially.

clue.text: Spout stupidly on top of rotunda, in a daze

indicators.note: on means next to, so the first letter follows
stupidly means foolishly, so the letters are jumbled
top of means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Someone talks nonsense on top of a domed building, dazed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a state of near-unconsciousness or numb bewilderment.

clue.text: Father looked on, agog

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father
eyed means watched or looked at

explanation.surface: A dad watches with wide-eyed eagerness.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wide-eyed with amazement or excitement, staring in wonder.

clue.text: Follow scholar's teaching

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar's degree

explanation.surface: Following a scholar's doctrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a dogma is a doctrine or set of principles laid down as true.

clue.text: Missile may be ear-piercing heading away

indicators.note: heading away means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a strident noise is loud and harsh

explanation.surface: A rocket launch may be deafening.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Trident is the submarine-launched nuclear missile used by the UK and US.

clue.text: Russian port's leading backer

parts.note: arch means chief or principal, as in arch-rival
an angel is a financial backer, especially of a theatre production

explanation.surface: A sponsor based in a Russian harbour city.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the White Sea port of Arkhangelsk is traditionally called this in English.

clue.text: Hike miles conveyed by horse-drawn carriage

indicators.note: the miles are carried within the carriage, so its letter goes inside

parts.note: a trap is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage

explanation.surface: Covering miles by pony and trap rather than walking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a long, tiring walk is a trek or slog on foot.

clue.text: Asian chief within shook hands

indicators.note: within says the letters lie inside the following words

explanation.surface: A Central Asian ruler greets visitors with a handshake.
explanation.definitionFit: Title: a ruler or chieftain among Mongol and Turkic peoples, as with Genghis.

clue.text: Whip food in retreat left by artist that's retired? I might

definitions.text: Whip food in retreat left by artist that's retired? I might

parts.note: a cat is a cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip

indicators.note: in retreat means the word for food goes backwards

parts.note: grub is slang for food

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn, so the letters for the artist run backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A thief speaks: I might whip (pinch) the snacks a pensioned-off painter left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whip' also means steal, so the whole clue describes the thief; 'by' places L before AR.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a burglar who climbs into buildings would be the one to steal from a retired artist's home.
